title: Identification and validation of prognostic markers for cuproptosis-related macrophage polarization genes in hepatocellular carcinoma.
summary: ML identifies a six-gene cuproptosis/macrophage-related HCC prognostic signature with an external survival cohort and supporting cell-line expression checks. It remains an observational prognostic association, not a causal mechanism or clinical biomarker validation.
